prompts: Use case: sketch-to-render. Image1 is LOCKED footprint geometry and camera. Image2 is ONLY architectural design and texture. Render the Ming Jiangnan large two-storey merchant residence from image2 ONTO image1's box and reproject all construction to image1 camera. Exact 2:1 dimetric, 45 degree yaw,30 degree elevation, thin base visible lines slope +0.500 and -0.500. Main front facing lower-left has FIVE equal-width bays; side facing lower-right has FOUR bays at exactly the same projected scale (footprint 10 by8 metres). Ground three visible vertices on square guide are LEFT(132,639), FRONT(554,850), RIGHT(892,681). Preserve these positions and ratio exactly. House upper floor straight brown wooden lattice windows, white lime plaster lower floor, simple center door, charcoal tiled pitched roof with white gable firebreak ends. Remove projecting side wing so footprint is a single clean rectangle. Realistic subdued matte weathered material and same fine details as image2. Light upper-left, tiny lower-right contact shadow. Fully opaque building, real TRANSPARENT RGBA background all outside alpha0. No outline, grid, text, pseudo-writing, people, trees, ornaments, thick plinth or halo. Complete roof and base with generous clear margin. One asset.

Use case: sketch-to-render. Texture and detail the enclosed BOX, preserving its exact camera and footprint. The front and side are almost equally broad: lower-left face10 metres and lower-right face8 metres. Do NOT make a long narrow facade. Exact ground vertices L132,639; F554,850; R892,681 (square1024 guide). Both edges slope plus/minus ONE HALF, no perspective convergence. Make a Ming Jiangnan two-storey merchant house with white plaster ground floor, chestnut brown timber upper floor straight lattice windows, grey stone footing, charcoal clay-tiled double pitched roof with white stepped firebreak gable ends. Door centered in lower-left face, no porch projections or side wings. Fine realistic weathered matte materials, separate roof tiles and timber joints, restrained warmth. Upper-left daylight. House exterior only, no person or landscape. True RGBA background alpha zero, subject opaque. Keep the box's lower silhouette EXACTLY fixed, add roof above. No annotations, text, signs, border, outline, platform, halo or scenery. Full building with generous transparent margin. One asset.
guide_note: Only rendering references; compensated guide variants test generator bias, never acceptance geometry. Acceptance always measured from actual PNG against fixed footprint and slopes.
